known_issue_strip_strategy_annotation_bl.issue: strip_strategy_annotation_block uses source.find('@strategy') which matches the FIRST occurrence. If '@strategy' appears in comments before the annotation, it matches the comment, finds no '{', and returns source unchanged — leaving @strategy unstripped, causing UnresolvedStrategyHole error.
